name: form-field
title: Form Field
description: A smart form field wrapper with built-in label, hint, and error support. Props-driven or compound mode. Uses namespace exports: FormField.Root, FormField.Label, FormField.Hint, FormField.Error.

migration.guide: v2 adds props-driven mode with label, hint, error, hasError, and disabled props on FormField.Root. New sub-components: FormField.Label, FormField.Hint, FormField.Error. Now requires label and hint as registryDependencies. Existing usage (children-only) is fully backward compatible.

docs.lead: A smart form field wrapper with built-in label, hint, and error support. Use props for common cases or compound sub-components for full control.
docs.usage:
import * as FormField from "@/components/ui/form-field"

<FormField.Root
  label="Email Address"
  htmlFor="email"
  required
  hint="This is a hint text."
>
  <Input.Composed id="email" placeholder="hello@example.com" />
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Props-driven form fields with label, hint, and various input types.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root
  label="Email Address"
  htmlFor="email"
  required
  labelSub="(Required)"
  labelInfo="We'll use this to contact you."
  hint="This is a hint text to help user."
>
  <Input.Composed id="email" leadingIcon={RiMailLine} placeholder="hello@example.com" />
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: With Error
examples.description: Form field with error state. Error replaces hint and auto-sets hasError.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root
  label="Email Address"
  htmlFor="email"
  required
  hint="This is a hint text."
  error="Please enter a valid email address."
>
  <Input.Composed id="email" leadingIcon={RiMailLine} hasError />
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Disabled form field. Disabled state flows to label and hint.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root
  label="Email Address"
  htmlFor="email"
  required
  hint="This is a hint text."
  disabled
>
  <Input.Composed id="email" leadingIcon={RiMailLine} disabled />
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Compound Mode
examples.description: Full control using sub-components. FormField.Label and FormField.Hint auto-read hasError/disabled from context.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root htmlFor="email" hasError>
  <FormField.Label required sub="(Required)">
    Email Address
  </FormField.Label>
  <Input.Root hasError>
    <Input.Wrapper>
      <Input.Icon as={RiMailLine} />
      <Input.Input id="email" placeholder="hello@example.com" />
    </Input.Wrapper>
  </Input.Root>
  <FormField.Error>Please enter a valid email address.</FormField.Error>
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Form Validation
examples.description: Complete sign-up form with Zod validation via react-hook-form. Shows real-world usage with multiple input types, composed and compound inputs, and live error messages.

api.name: FormField.Root
api.description: The root form field container. Provides context for hasError/disabled to sub-components.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text. When provided, renders a composed Label automatically.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: Links label to input via htmlFor/id. Also passed to sub-components via context.

props.name: labelInfo
props.description: Info tooltip content rendered as Label.Info

props.name: hint
props.description: Hint text rendered below children. Hidden when error is present.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. When truthy, replaces hint and sets hasError in context.

props.name: hasError
props.description: Error state. Auto-set when error prop is truthy.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disabled state. Flows to label and hint via context.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional className to override or extend styling

api.name: FormField.Label
api.description: Composed label that auto-reads disabled and htmlFor from FormField context.

api.name: FormField.Hint
api.description: Composed hint that auto-reads hasError and disabled from FormField context.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon component. Defaults to built-in info circle.

api.name: FormField.Error
api.description: Error message display with error styling. Returns null when children is falsy.

api.name: useFormField
api.description: Hook to access FormField context (hasError, disabled, id) from custom child components.
